items.quote: Ken is great to work with. He just got done painting my house and far exceeded my expectations. Several neighbors have told me how good it looks. I highly recommend him.

We are so happy we chose Ken to paint our house. He is very professional and detail oriented. His workmanship is superb. We had peeling, old paint and he made it look new again on our soffit and fascia. We will definitely be recommending him!

Went to the Sherwin Williams store and asked for a painter recommendation. They offered a few while saying Ken would probably be too busy, so I naturally called him first. Incredible from start to finish.
